title: Lane T2 — PostgreSQL Operational Data Plane Architectural Audit

external_sources_consulted.title: PostgreSQL JSON/JSONB Design and Indexing
external_sources_consulted.key_findings: jsonb_path_ops GIN indexes preferred for containment-heavy queries. Targeted expression indexes for narrow access paths. Avoid blanket GIN indexes on high-write tables. jsonb over json for all operational storage.

external_sources_consulted.title: PostgreSQL LISTEN
external_sources_consulted.key_findings: LISTEN registers per-connection, takes effect at COMMIT. Two-phase setup pattern required: commit LISTEN then inspect baseline state. Notifications lost on disconnect.

external_sources_consulted.title: PostgreSQL NOTIFY
external_sources_consulted.key_findings: NOTIFY delivers on COMMIT only. Payload limited to 8000 bytes string. Identical channel+payload deduplicated within transaction. Use for lightweight refresh signalling, not event authority.

external_sources_consulted.title: PostgreSQL Materialized Views
external_sources_consulted.key_findings: CONCURRENTLY refresh requires UNIQUE index covering all rows. Non-concurrent refresh takes ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock. WITH NO DATA + REFRESH pattern for deferred population.

external_sources_consulted.title: Psycopg 3 Transaction Management
external_sources_consulted.key_findings: autocommit=True recommended to prevent idle-in-transaction. Transaction blocks via conn.transaction() context manager. SAEPOINT-based nested transactions. Handle InFailedSqlTransaction by issuing rollback().

architectural_decisions.decision: Use psycopg 3 as the sole PostgreSQL driver; no SQLAlchemy, Alembic, asyncpg, or pgvector.
architectural_decisions.rationale: Mission explicitly forbids SQLite, SQLAlchemy, Alembic, and pgvector. Psycopg 3 is the Python 3.12+ standard PostgreSQL driver. No competing ORM or migration framework introduced.
architectural_decisions.evidence: pyproject.toml dependency: psycopg>=3.2.0. Zero imports of sqlalchemy, alembic, asyncpg, pgvector anywhere in data_plane/.

architectural_decisions.decision: Canonical evidence remains authority; PostgreSQL stores digest/reference metadata and derived operational projections only.
architectural_decisions.rationale: Schema-validated evidence artifacts and append-only ledgers remain authoritative for governed transitions. PostgreSQL rows are rebuildable from canonical evidence.
architectural_decisions.evidence: EvidenceSource model stores only evidence_id (content-hash-derived), evidence_kind, evidence_sha256, source_ledger_path_hash, source_schema_version, provenance (content-light). No raw content.

architectural_decisions.decision: DuckDB remains the disposable read-side analytics engine; PostgreSQL is the operational projection substrate.
architectural_decisions.rationale: DuckDB is in-memory, disposable, analytics-only. PostgreSQL provides durable, queryable operational projections. The two databases do not compete.
architectural_decisions.evidence: DuckDB code in analytics/, events/ unchanged. No cross-contamination between DuckDB and PostgreSQL authority.

architectural_decisions.decision: Use autocommit=True as default connection mode with explicit transaction blocks for atomic operations.
architectural_decisions.rationale: Per psycopg3 best practices: autocommit prevents idle-in-transaction, ensures timely NOTIFY delivery. conn.transaction() contexts for atomic work.
architectural_decisions.evidence: PostgresConnectionConfig defaults autocommit=True. transactional_cursor context manager wraps conn.transaction().

architectural_decisions.decision: Migration system is file-based with ordered, idempotent SQL migrations tracked in _migrations table.
architectural_decisions.rationale: Simplicity. No Alembic dependency. Migrations are just SQL files in migrations/ directory. Each records success/failure in _migrations. Schema version in _schema_version.
architectural_decisions.evidence: _migrations.py discovers SQL files, applies in order, records results. 001_initial_schema.sql creates all foundation tables.

architectural_decisions.decision: NOTIFY used for lightweight refresh signalling only; never carries authoritative data. Payload is projection name string.
architectural_decisions.rationale: Per PostgreSQL docs: NOTIFY on COMMIT only, payload limited to 8000 bytes. Use as signalling seam, not event authority.
architectural_decisions.evidence: notify_projection_refresh sends NOTIFY with projection name payload. Channel registry table for listener tracking.

architectural_decisions.decision: Tests run against a real disposable PostgreSQL database. No SQLite, no in-memory substitute, no test doubles.
architectural_decisions.rationale: Mission requires real PostgreSQL proofs. Test fixtures create/drop disposable databases. All 42 tests execute against real PostgreSQL 17.
architectural_decisions.evidence: conftest.py creates random-named database per session, drops on teardown. test_no_sqlite_imports verifies zero sqlite/alchemy imports.
